original_test_intent: Run the RVS MEM module on the approved GPUs and prove its memory allocation, transfer and data-integrity results meet the AMD GPU specification without new memory/system errors.
original_method: Build immutable ROCm/RVS, review `mem.conf` target/allocation/pattern/iteration actions, snapshot GPU memory/ECC/MCE state, execute exact debug-3 command once with memory headroom and watchdog, and reconcile every target/result plus counter deltas and logs.
manual_activity: GPU memory/RAS owner approves mem.conf scope, reservation and error thresholds, supervises recovery and decides outcome.
required_inputs: GPU memory topology/capacity and control-plane headroom
AMD-model performance/data-integrity limits and ECC/RAS counter semantics
safety_requirements: Preflight memory capacity/topology and preserve headroom
Snapshot ECC/MCE/RAS before run without clearing evidence
Use external watchdog and one attempt
Monitor memory use, miscompare, ECC/MCE, OOM, driver reset, temperature/power
Abort on any unsafe/error condition and recover deliberately
agent_execution_scope: Verify immutable build/config and target allocation
Capture all target/pattern/results and counter deltas
Stop/recover/report without changing thresholds or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve memory config, targets, limits and RAS semantics
Review data/counter/health findings and set result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic mem.conf invocation changes the source path and omits build, allocation/pattern, memory-error and safety coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute `../bin/rvs -c conf/mem.conf -d 3` from approved hashes with reserved headroom, external watchdog and complete per-GPU memory/RAS evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact mem.conf, debug 3 and build steps are retained; runtime is governed by approved config/watchdog rather than 5/5 metadata.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Expand reviewed mem.conf into expected GPU/allocation/pattern actions, bind outputs to stable GPU IDs and compare data/errors/performance with pre/post RAS deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes GPU-memory coverage and failure detection explicit rather than relying on process exit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No generic allocation test, Oblex output or another RVS module substitutes for mem.conf.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Corrected ECC deltas may be tolerated only under an explicit platform oracle; the agent must not infer one.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines allowed GPU memory allocation, expected patterns/actions and ECC/RAS counter thresholds for the exact model/config.
expected_evidence: Pinned source/build BOM and mem.conf hash/content
Cleanup/recovery, anomaly dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently specifies mem.conf; DeepSeek's generic alternative is incomplete, not authoritative conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Artifacts, memory/RAS oracle and safety approvals can be supplied.

review_improvement: Adds config-derived memory coverage, reserved headroom and RAS counter deltas to the exact RVS MEM run.
independent_technical_reasoning: A MEM module can exit without proving all GPUs, allocations or patterns ran, and a corrected error may appear only in RAS counters. Mapping config actions to stable GPU IDs and comparing the complete roster catches skips. Reserving memory for the OS/agent is also essential: an OOM-induced abort tests host starvation rather than the intended GPU memory path.
